start: Menu, 'Shop', gym with the member app on

steps.action: Open Shop and tap the tab 'Products'
user_sees: Line '<n> products · <m> shown in the app' and the button '+ Add product'; one card per product
must_not: 'Loading your products…' that never ends
Products of another gym

steps.action: Tap '+ Add product'
user_sees: Sheet 'Add product' with Name, Category, Price, 'Description (optional)', 'Picture if there’s no photo', Colour, 'Shown in the app', Choices and Stock; buttons 'Cancel' and 'Add product'
must_not: Values of the product edited before left in the boxes

steps.action: Type a name, a price and a stock number, tap 'Add product'
user_sees: The button reads 'Saving…', the sheet closes, note '<name> added to the shop.'; the new card is in the list
must_not: Two products from two taps
The price saved 100 times too big or too small
The product missing after a refresh

start: Products list (another kind: change a product)

steps.action: Tap a product card
user_sees: Sheet 'Edit product' with the saved values; buttons 'Delete', 'Cancel', 'Save changes'
must_not: Stock shown as it was before members' latest orders

steps.action: Change the price, tap 'Save changes'
user_sees: Note '<name> saved.' and the new price on the card
must_not: Stock set back to an old number by saving the price
Old orders changing their price

start: Add or edit sheet (another kind: a product with choices)

steps.action: Turn Choices on
user_sees: 'Comes in flavours or sizes, each with its own stock' in place of 'One kind, one stock number'; 'What is the choice?' and rows with a name, Stock, 'Own price (optional)' and 'Colour (optional)'
must_not: The single stock number kept as well as the choices' stock

steps.action: Add two choices with stock, save
user_sees: The card shows the number of choices and the total stock
must_not: A choice saved without stock
The total not equal to the sum of the choices

start: Products list (other ways: the quick buttons on a card)

steps.action: Tap the add-10 button on a card
user_sees: Note 'Added 10 to <name>. <n> in stock now.' (with the choice named when the product has choices)
must_not: Stock set to a fixed number that undoes a member's order made a moment ago
20 added by a fast double tap

steps.action: Tap 'Hide from app', then 'Show in app'
user_sees: Notes '<name> is hidden from the app.' then '<name> is shown in the app again.'; the count 'shown in the app' follows
must_not: A hidden product still for sale in the member app
Hiding changing price, stock or old orders

steps.action: On a card with no photo tap 'Add photo' and pick a picture
user_sees: 'Uploading…' then note 'Photo added to <name>. Members see it in the app now.'
must_not: The photo on another product
A failed upload that still says the photo was added

start: Add product sheet

steps.action: Leave the name empty and tap 'Add product'
user_sees: 'Please fix the boxes marked in red.' and under the name 'Give the product a name.'
must_not: A product with no name saved
The sheet closing

steps.action: Type a price of 0, or stock 'ten'
user_sees: A message under the box: stock 'Stock must be a whole number from 0 to 1,00,000.'; a refused price says 'Something in this form isn’t allowed. Check the price (₹1 to ₹1,00,000) and stock.'
must_not: A free or negative-price product in the member app
The typed values wiped

steps.action: Give two choices the same name
user_sees: 'Two choices have the same name.'
must_not: Two choices members cannot tell apart

steps.action: Save an edit after a member ordered the product meanwhile
user_sees: 'This product changed while you were editing. Someone may have ordered it. We loaded the new details. Check them and save again.' with the new stock in the form and a photo just uploaded kept
must_not: The older stock saved over the member's order
'This product was deleted while you were editing it.' missing when it was deleted

start: Products list, one product shown in the app

steps.action: Hide it, then show it again
user_sees: The card and the count change each time; nothing else on the product changes
must_not: Stock or price changed by hiding

steps.action: Open it, tap 'Delete'
user_sees: Sheet 'Delete <name>?' with 'It goes from the app at once. Old orders for it stay as they are. If you may sell it again, use Hide from app instead.' and the button 'Delete product'
must_not: The product deleted by the first tap

steps.action: Tap 'Delete product'
user_sees: 'Deleting…' then note '<name> deleted.'; the card is gone; there is no undo
must_not: Old orders losing the item's name or price
The product still for sale in the member app
An open order for it that can no longer be handed over

steps.action: Think of who sees a product
